newsitem.title: USA: ConEd 975 MW N.Y. nuke seen up within weeks.
newsitem.headline: ConEd 975 MW N.Y. nuke seen up within weeks.

text.p: Consolidated Edison of New York Inc's (ConEd) 975 megawatt Indian Point nuclear power unit 2 should return to service within the next several weeks after a maintenance outage, a company spokeswoman said.
"It should return to service sometime over the next couple of weeks," spokeswoman Joan Burger said, adding the company has not yet set a specific date for a restart.
The unit, located at Indian Point, N.Y., was shut Jan 27 for support work on the non-nuclear side of the plant.
During the outage, the company discovered a problem linked to cleaning material in the unit's feedwater and condensate systems.
The Nuclear Regulatory Commission gave a tentative restart date for Indian Point 2 of February 19 in its daily plant status report Thursday morning.
